mapper.select: SELECT a.accommodation_no as accommodationNo, a.accommodation_name as accommodationName, a.accommodation_address as accommodationAddress, r.filepath as filepath FROM likes l JOIN member m ON l.member_no = m.member_no JOIN accommodation a ON l.accommodation_no = a.accommodation_no JOIN room_image r ON a.accommodation_no = r.accommodation_no WHERE l.member_no = #{memberNo};
mapper.delete: delete from likes where accommodation_no = #{accommodationNo} and member_no = #{memberNo}
